The root cause is a misconfigured init container named "hang-init" (using busybox:1.36 image) that runs "sleep infinity" as its command. This init container never completes, causing all 3 pods to remain in Init:0/1 state indefinitely, preventing the main container (custom-service-main, a Python HTTP server on port 8080) from ever starting. This makes the custom-service completely unavailable.
